title: A constrained symbolic regression approach for Lyapunov function discovery
summary: In this paper, we consider the data-driven discovery of Lyapunov functions for autonomous dynamical systems. We represent the Lyapunov function as an expression tree of fixed depth and formulate the Lyapunov discovery task as a constrained self-supervised symbolic regression problem. The constraints model the output of the Lyapunov function for a given input as well as the Lyapunov stability conditions.
